title: Ethical Considerations of Large Language Models in Game Playing
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark measures gender bias in Large Language Models when acting as agents in the social deduction game Werewolf.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its findings focus exclusively on gender bias, showing that LLMs exhibit discriminatory tendencies based on both explicit gender labels and implicit gender cues from names.
